findings.description: The routed fetch omits all browser request headers, including cookies. Cookies established in the fresh browser context are not sent to later same-origin requests, so session-dependent product data can fail to load or be incorrect. Forward appropriately scoped cookies and required safe headers without leaking credentials across origins; cover same-origin and cross-origin cases.

Supporting evidence references and nested item excerpts always use addEvidence's raw default even when their underlying content was extracted from rendered HTML. The resulting report misstates the provenance of browser-rendered supporting evidence. Preserve method for all evidence and test mixed initial and rendered findings.

limitations: Static targeted review only; no live provider calls, deployment, full test execution, or verification of final changes.
Initial findings are retained above as historical review observations; see reReview for their disposition.
Process, fresh-agent exit evidence, source-bound evaluation and hosted CI were not available for final assessment at the time of review.

Supporting resources use bounded public egress and scoped browser cookies; product navigation is not repeated.
